details.effect: [fanfare] Summon a Dutiful Steed token. [act] [engage] this card and 2 Mount cards on your field: Select an enemy leader or enemy follower on the field and deal it 2 damage.

issues: Activated ability cost is encoded incorrectly: it should require engaging this card and 2 Mount cards on your field, not burying 2 followers. Replace the cost with an engage-self-plus-2-Mount-engage cost representation instead of buryFromField/buryFieldCount.
Activated ability target is encoded too broadly: it should target an enemy leader or an enemy follower, not any enemy field card. Encode the damage target as enemy leader or enemy follower only.

details.effect: On Evolve: Look at the top 9 cards of your deck. You may put up to 3 cards that cost 3 play points or less from among them into your EX area. They cost 3 less to play this turn. Put the remaining cards on the bottom of your deck in any order.

issues: On Evolve effect is incomplete: it should let you put up to 3 cards that cost 3 or less from among the top 9 cards into your EX area, but the encoding only supports choosing one. Encode selection of up to 3 qualifying cards from the 9 looked at cards.
On Evolve effect is missing duration on the cost reduction: the chosen cards should cost 3 less to play this turn, not permanently.
